text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much for having me
today!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It is truly an honor
to join you for tea.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, there is no need to be so stiff
just because you are before first-class King, Satono-san!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, indeed! Let's chat without reservation
and enjoy lots of sweets!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, please take a seat over here.
Let us enjoy our time together today, Satono-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Would you care for some jam cookies with your tea?
They are an exquisite treat sent by my grandmother, you know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow...! Yes, absolutely!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—My, so the Charity Cup the other day
was also hosted by your family, Satono-san?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I went along as well
to lend my parents a hand.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I had heard rumors, but your family is
truly passionate about such philanthropic activities, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I often hear your parents' names in high society.
Known as prominent philanthropists with immense wealth.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm honored that you know of them,
King-san!♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And it's wonderful that you properly help out
your parents too, Satono-san!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Ever since I was little, seeing my parents
extend helping hands to people and seeing how great they are—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I naturally grew up wanting to follow in their footsteps
and become just like them!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I understand, I understand completely!
"As a princess, one must help others!"
That is what you mean, right?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Eh? Ah, yes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A distinguished family of high standing and renowned philanthropy—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And the long-awaited horse girl born to that house
has now enrolled here at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There must be... a great many people
keeping their eyes on you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...McQueen-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I happened to see Satono Diamond
being interviewed by a reporter.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otome
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your valuable time,
Satono Diamond-san!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otome
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, we've received an enormous
number of requests eagerly awaiting
this solo feature on you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so? I'm honored!♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otome
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it really shows just how high
everyone's expectations are for you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otome
text_block_list.text: I'll have to put my best effort into writing it! Well then, please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: High expectations, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good work on the interview, Satono-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, McQueen-san!
Hello.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As the reporter mentioned... your feature article
will surely be read by countless people.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. If so, that makes me very happy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Do you never feel it as a heavy pressure?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for your concern,
McQueen-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: However, I am perfectly fine!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My family, and everyone connected to our group,
celebrated my birth and placed their hopes on my success.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
All of that serves as my pillar of support—
and I could never see it as anything else!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, it seems my concern was entirely unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In that case, allow me to offer encouragement rather than caution.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Fulfilling the duty of one's birth" is
no easy feat, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
I wouldn't have it any other way, McQueen-san!
